title: Release video: what changed
description: A release or wave summary for the site and the repo: the version and date, then each change with its status word, taken from the release notes; nothing that is not in them.

body.subject: Lampway {{version}}, {{date}}: the changes listed in {{notes_source}}, at most {{max_items}}, each with its status word (Live, Built, Built, not run live, Partial).
body.action: The version and date set first; each change enters as a row with its status chip, holds for at least {{read_s}} s, and stacks; the last frame shows every row at once and holds for 2 s.
body.camera: Fixed frame; rows slide in from one side only.
body.style: Night surface; the version in the site's serif; status chips in the site's status colours (go, flame, dusk); {{palette}}.
body.constraints: Write ONE scene folder: an HTML entry plus its JS, CSS, fonts and images, nothing fetched from elsewhere. Expose window.__scene = {duration_s, width, height}, an async window.__setup() that loads every font and decodes every image, then returns an object with both required arrays. Setup return example: {"fonts":[{"font":"16px Fixture Sans","ok":true}],"images":[{"src":"assets/figure.png","ok":true}]}. Each font or src identifier must be a non-empty string; ok must be a boolean, with true meaning the resource loaded. Empty-resource setup: {"fonts":[],"images":[]} is legitimate when no fonts or images are needed. window.__frame(t) sets EVERY animated property from t (seconds) alone. window.__audit() must return an object with both required arrays describing all visible text and marks at the captured time. Audit return example: {"text":[{"sel":"#title","text":"Title","box":[100,100,500,160],"font_px":28,"opacity":1}],"marks":[{"sel":"figure","box":[600,200,1000,700]}]}. Each row needs a non-empty sel and box=[x0,y0,x1,y1] in viewport pixels, with finite numeric coordinates ordered x0 <= x1 and y0 <= y1. Text rows additionally require string text, positive finite font_px and finite opacity in [0,1]; marks require sel and box. Empty audit: {"text":[],"marks":[]} is legitimate only when no text or marks are visible. No Date, performance.now, Math.random, requestAnimationFrame, CSS animations or CSS transitions: easing and any flicker are closed-form functions of t. All text inside the 5% title-safe area, at least {{min_text_px}} px tall at the output size, with contrast of at least 4.5:1 (3:1 at 24 px and up). No text over a busy image without a plate behind it. Every row's text and status are quoted from the notes; a change the notes mark as not run live says so on screen.

min_text_px.description: the smallest text at the output size; the self-check fails under 22

palette.default: the brand's own tokens from the supplied stylesheet
palette.description: where the colours come from; never invented

notes_source.description: project-relative path of the release notes or the roadmap rows

negatives: no change that is not in the notes
no status upgraded beyond the notes

gates.description: requests other than file: and data: during the render (the scene must be self-contained)
sampled frame with no visible mark: share of pixels carrying a local luminance step
warning only: a nearly empty sampled frame (a weak poster frame)
visible text box outside the 5% title-safe margin
measured contrast of fully visible authored text against the pixels around it (3.0 at 24 px and up)
authored text overlapping a figure or card box
frames differing when the receipt is re-rendered by verify (same engine, sequential order)
